home_title.en: Go LLM API for Claude Code, OpenAI, Gemini - go-llm-router

en.home: Go LLM library: one LLM API for 15 providers incl. Claude Code, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. By 邱敬幃 Pardn Chiu.
en.getting-started: Install go-llm-router, resolve an Agent from a provider@model name, and send your first request with usage counters.
en.architecture: How router.New, the provider adapters, the OAuth token store, and the shared stream and usage pipeline fit together.
en.core-concepts: The single Agent interface every provider implements, plus the optional stream, reasoning, image, STT, and TTS capabilities.
en.core-concepts-routing: How router.New resolves provider@model names, rewrites unknown prefixes to compat, and lets you switch providers by name.
en.core-concepts-reasoning: The six reasoning levels, their aliases, how they map to each vendor, and how out-of-range requests are clamped.
en.core-concepts-fast-mode: How ModeFast maps to each vendor's priority tier, checking support with SupportFast, and the fast-tier downgrade warning.
en.core-concepts-tool-calls: Declaring tools in the OpenAI shape with a raw JSON Schema, returning tool results, and echoing Gemini thought signatures.
en.core-concepts-streaming: Consuming normalized SendStream events, handling StreamError failures, and the watchdog that ends stalled or looping streams.
en.core-concepts-usage: How vendor token fields fold into one Usage struct and how cached tokens move from Input into CacheRead.
en.core-concepts-sessions: How WithSessionID becomes a prompt_cache_key or session header per provider, and how WithCacheTTL sets the Claude Code cache.
en.core-concepts-images: Picking image models by provider@model, calling GenerateImage, and how ImageOptions aspect ratio and size map per vendor.
en.core-concepts-speech: Default TTS voices, supported output formats per provider, and local OpenRouter voice validation.
en.core-concepts-model-filters: Listing models with TextOnly, STTOnly, TTSOnly, and ImageOnly filters, marker rules, and per-provider flag support.
en.core-concepts-claude-code: Running the local Claude Code CLI as a model: EnableClaude, one process per session, prompt-cache TTL, and resume.
en.core-concepts-claude-code-tools: How claude-code emulates tool calls with a text protocol, find_tools schema lookup, and the call formats it parses.
en.configuration: The router.Config fields and which API key, OAuth token, base URL, or Cloudflare IDs each provider prefix requires.
en.configuration-oauth: Keychain keys, login flows, legacy key fallback, and automatic refresh for Copilot, Codex, and Grok OAuth tokens.
en.configuration-endpoints: Pointing go-llm-router at self-hosted or third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Cloudflare Workers AI Gateway.
en.configuration-limits: Request, response-header, and listing timeouts, the 50-second SSE stream watchdog, and error and audio body read caps.
en.configuration-quota: Which provider packages report remaining credits, balance, or quota percentage, and what each value means.
en.api-reference: Agent and its optional interfaces, router.Config and router.New, the PROVIDER_* constants, and each provider package's exports.
en.api-reference-messages: Fields of Message, ContentPart, Tool, ToolCall, ToolCallFunction, Output, OutputChoices, and Usage.
en.api-reference-reasoning: Reasoning and Mode constants plus ParseReasoning, ClampReasoning, OpenAIEffortRange, SupportFast, and WarnFastDowngrade.
en.api-reference-model-filters: ModelFilter, ModelInfo, the IsTextModel family of classifiers, and MatchModelFilter signatures.
en.api-reference-streaming: StreamEvent, StreamError, SSE helpers like OpenStream and ScanSSE, the WatchIdle watchdog, DecodeFrame, and read caps.
en.api-reference-images: ImageOptions and ImageResult, image endpoints and output formats per provider, ImagePixelSize and DataURI.
en.api-reference-audio: STT and TTS option and result types, audio endpoints per provider, and the PCMRate and WrapPCM16 helpers.
en.api-reference-oauth: Load, HasToken, ClearToken, LoginWithCallback, and EnsureFresh across the Copilot, Codex, and Grok OAuth packages.
en.api-reference-helpers: NewHTTPClient, SupportTemperature, ResponsesAPI, summary.VoiceReply, and the WithSessionID and WithCacheTTL helpers.
en.api-reference-removed: Exported go-llm-router symbols removed since v0.2.0, the release that removed each, and its replacement.

zh.home: Go 多模型 LLM 函式庫：以單一 API 串接 Claude Code、OpenAI、Gemini 等 15 家 AI API，邱敬幃開發。
zh.getting-started: 安裝 go-llm-router，用 provider@model 取得 Agent，送出第一個請求並讀取用量。
zh.architecture: router.New、供應商轉接層、OAuth 權杖存取與共用串流／用量管線如何組合。
zh.core-concepts: 所有供應商實作的單一 Agent 介面，以及串流、推理、圖片、STT、TTS 選用能力。
zh.core-concepts-routing: router.New 如何解析 provider@model、把未知前綴改寫為 compat，並以名稱切換供應商。
zh.core-concepts-reasoning: 六個推理等級與別名、各家對映方式，以及超出範圍時的收斂規則。
zh.core-concepts-fast-mode: ModeFast 對映各家優先層級、以 SupportFast 判斷支援，以及降級警告。
zh.core-concepts-tool-calls: 以 OpenAI 形狀與 JSON Schema 宣告工具、回傳工具結果，並原樣回傳 Gemini 簽章。
zh.core-concepts-streaming: 消費正規化的 SendStream 事件、處理 StreamError，以及結束停滯或重複輸出串流的監控機制。
zh.core-concepts-usage: 各家 token 欄位如何折疊成單一 Usage，以及快取 token 如何自 Input 移入 CacheRead。
zh.core-concepts-sessions: WithSessionID 如何轉成各供應商的快取鍵或 session header，以及 WithCacheTTL 如何設定 Claude Code 快取。
zh.core-concepts-images: 以 provider@model 選圖片模型、呼叫 GenerateImage，以及 ImageOptions 比例與尺寸的對映。
zh.core-concepts-speech: 各供應商的預設 TTS voice、支援的輸出格式，以及 OpenRouter 的本地 voice 驗證。
zh.core-concepts-model-filters: 以 TextOnly、STTOnly、TTSOnly、ImageOnly 列出模型、標記規則與各供應商支援。
zh.core-concepts-claude-code: 以本機 Claude Code CLI 作為模型：EnableClaude、每個 session 一個程序、快取 TTL 與接續。
zh.core-concepts-claude-code-tools: claude-code 如何以文字協定模擬工具呼叫、以 find_tools 取得 schema，以及可解析的格式。
zh.configuration: router.Config 欄位，以及各供應商前綴需要的 API 金鑰、OAuth 權杖、BaseURL 或 Cloudflare ID。
zh.configuration-oauth: Copilot、Codex、Grok OAuth 權杖的 keychain 鍵、登入流程、舊鍵相容與自動刷新。
zh.configuration-endpoints: 把 go-llm-router 指向自架或第三方 OpenAI 相容端點，以及 Cloudflare Workers AI Gateway。
zh.configuration-limits: 請求、response header 與模型清單逾時、50 秒的 SSE 串流監控，以及錯誤與音訊 body 讀取上限。
zh.configuration-quota: 哪些供應商套件回報剩餘點數、餘額或配額百分比，以及各值的意義。
zh.api-reference: Agent 與選用介面、router.Config 與 router.New、PROVIDER_* 常數，以及各供應商套件的匯出。
zh.api-reference-reasoning: Reasoning 與 Mode 常數，以及 ParseReasoning、ClampReasoning、SupportFast 等函式。
zh.api-reference-model-filters: ModelFilter、ModelInfo、IsTextModel 系列分類函式與 MatchModelFilter 簽名。
zh.api-reference-streaming: StreamEvent、StreamError、OpenStream 等 SSE 輔助函式、WatchIdle 監控、DecodeFrame 與讀取上限。
zh.api-reference-images: ImageOptions 與 ImageResult、各供應商圖片端點與格式、ImagePixelSize 與 DataURI。
zh.api-reference-audio: STT 與 TTS 選項與結果型別、各供應商語音端點，以及 PCMRate 與 WrapPCM16。
zh.api-reference-helpers: NewHTTPClient、SupportTemperature、ResponsesAPI、VoiceReply 與 session、快取 TTL 輔助函式。
zh.api-reference-removed: v0.2.0 起移除的 go-llm-router 匯出符號、移除版本與替代做法。
